what: A 40 × 30 × 20 block across the front and side planes (x −20..20, y −15..15, z 0..20) less a 20 × 25 × 20 box over its front right top corner: a corner notch 10 × 15 × 10. Each face of the tool crosses the block or misses it; none lies on one of the block's (that needs 36).

recipe.do: Start a new part and delete its ready-made box (feature-1) from the timeline, as the L bracket's make does, so the counter goes on from 2. (Since 35e2 a body keeps its number for good, so the deleted box keeps Body 1 and the next bodies are Body 2 and Body 3; and each rectangle adds its four horizontal and vertical constraints, ids 11 to 14 here, so the items after it are numbered 4 later: corrected 11-06 with the step-35 models made.)
Create Sketch on the top plane XY.
Rectangle tool: click (−20, −15), then (20, 15) (points 3, 4, 6, 8 and lines 5, 7, 9, 10, the tool's order). Nothing is before it, so nothing is pinned.
Extrude the sketch 20 (towards +Z): Body 2, the block x −20..20, y −15..15, z 0..20, across the front and side planes.
Create Sketch on the front plane XZ (sketch x is X, sketch y is Z, its normal −Y).

Rectangle tool: click (10, 10), then (30, 30) (x 10..30, z 10..30; points and lines 17 to 24); seen along Y the block offers its corners (±20, 0 or 20), its edges' middles (0, 0), (0, 20), (±20, 0), (±20, 20), (±20, 10) and nothing else, so no point here is pinned.
Extrude the sketch 25, not flipped (along −Y, y 0 to −25): Body 3, the tool x 10..30, y −25..0, z 10..30.
Combine: target Body 2, tool Body 3, Cut, Keep tools off (Fusion's default): Body 2 is the block with the notch, Body 3 is used up.

volume.why: the block less where the tool overlaps it: x 10..20 (the block ends at 20), y −15..0 (it begins at −15), z 10..20 (it ends at 20), 10 × 15 × 10: 24000 − 1500

area.why: the block's area unchanged: the notch takes 15 × 10 off its right side (x = 20), 10 × 10 off its front (y = −15) and 10 × 15 off its top (z = 20), and its three walls x = 10 (15 × 10), y = 0 (10 × 10) and z = 10 (10 × 15) give the same back: 2(1200 + 800 + 600) = 5200

topology.why: the block's 6 faces (its right side, front and top now L-shaped, 6 sides each, still one face each) and the notch's 3 walls; the block's 12 edges (the three into the corner shortened) and the notch's 9 (its box's 12 less the 3 along the block's edges at the corner, cut away); the block's corners less the one cut away, 7, and the notch's 7 others: 14 − 21 + 9 = 2, one shell, no hole through

box.why: the block's: the notch takes the corner (20, −15, 20), but (20, 15, 20), (−20, −15, 20) and (20, −15, 0) still reach each side

tolerance.why: LINEAR (10 nm) plus the rounding of the crossing points inside faces: such a point is only known to 64 ulps of the lengths it was worked from (the kernel's facts table gives it the edge's tolerance plus that rounding, by design and by its own hand test), and each of its three lengths in the boolean's frame is at most the diagonal of the box round both bodies, D, so at most 64·2⁻⁵²·max(1, 3D) past LINEAR. Corrected 11-06 when the model was first made: the first expectation, exactly 1e-5, left that rounding out. Here D = √(50² + 40² + 30²) ≈ 70.7 (both bodies: x −20..30, y −25..15, z 0..30): ≈ 3e-12.
